# Manifest of packages shipped by the distinctionos-cache artifact.
# These are packages that install cleanly via dnf, but live on custom or
# at-risk remotes — we pre-cache them so build failures aren't dependent
# on those remotes staying up.
#
# Format: NAME|SOURCE|ARG
#
# Source types:
#   dnf             Download from configured dnf repos via dnf-download.
#                   ARG = optional comma-separated --enablerepo list.
#   github-release  Pull .rpm assets from a repo's latest GitHub release.
#                   ARG = OWNER/REPO.
#   github-build    Clone repo, build with meson/cmake/make, package as RPM via fpm.
#                   ARG = OWNER/REPO[@REF]. Ref may be a branch, tag, or commit.
#                   If your build needs extra deps, add them to the Containerfile.
#                   For repo-specific patches, drop a script at hooks/<NAME>.sh —
#                   it runs in the cloned source dir before the build starts.
#
# Comments (lines starting with #) and blank lines are ignored.
# Whitespace around | separators is stripped.
#
# Examples:
#   audacity-freeworld | dnf            | rpmfusion-free,rpmfusion-free-updates
#   glycin-libs        | github-release | phantomcortex/glycin

audacity-freeworld | dnf            | rpmfusion-free,rpmfusion-free-updates
